regime_context: China A-shares show a narrow one-narrative tape: Coal is the sole eligible leader (Hurst 'mean-revert', durability only 0.52), while the next two spots (Gold Miners, Banks) are ineligible or crowded, and breadth of rotation is just 2/22. Critically, the absolute-trend gate has no drawdown edge on this market's history (gate_helps=false), so the whole detector is display-grade here and I lean low.

theses.subject: Coal
theses.thesis: Coal is the only eligible leader (rank 1, score 0.992, eligible=true) and is not crowded (crowding_z 0.59). The absolute-trend gate is the one validated de-risking leg, and Coal passes it. However, its Hurst tag is mean-revert and durability is modest at 0.52, so this is a fragile trend rather than a strong one.
theses.dissent: Coal is a mean-reverting tape with only moderate durability; in a one-narrative A-share regime, leadership can rotate out fast and the rank offers no return-forecast edge (rank-IC ~0).

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks are eligible and trend-tagged (durability 0.83, breadth 1.0 — the strongest structural trend in the set), but are crowded (crowding_z 1.83, crowded=true). Crowding is a size-down caution only, never a fade; since no position can be sized appropriately as a fresh lean, the honest direction is to avoid initiating.
theses.dissent: Banks have the best durability and breadth in the set and are one of only two eligible themes; avoiding them could mean missing the only structurally sound trend in a choppy tape.

falsifier.text: Banks ETF 512800.SS leads the CSI 300 by more than 5% over a 20-day window while crowding_z falls below 1.0
